title: Credits
description: The data, engine, music and textures PokéIQ is built on, and their licences.
battlesBody: Battles run on Pokémon Showdown's simulator, and its battle timer and replay format are adapted from Pokémon Showdown (MIT licence, © Guangcong Luo and contributors).
musicBody: Original chiptune by Ted Kerr, celestialghost8 and congusbongus via OpenGameArt.org, under CC0 (credits).
sizesBody: Music by cynicmusic and city textures from Poly Haven, both CC0 (credits).
raceBody: Stadium textures from Poly Haven and crowd sounds from OpenGameArt.org, all CC0 (credits).
filmsBody: The scores are original, written for PokéIQ and played with the MuseScore General sound font (MIT; strings from VSCO 2 CE, CC0). Credits: <world>History of the Pokémon World</world>, <story>Story of Pokémon</story>.
